summary: Melco Resorts Finance Limited, a subsidiary of Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited, filed a Form 6-K notice of redemption for all US$600,000,000 of its 5.625% Senior Notes due 2027. The redemption date is September 23, 2026, at 100.000% of principal plus accrued interest, pursuant to the indenture. The action is a debt redemption reducing leverage; it does not involve equity, a spin-off, or an acquisition. Watch for the redemption process and any future capital markets activity by the issuer.
